[font=Comic Sans MS][i][color=#fce5cd][size=4]Other Plans[/size][/color][/i]
[i][b]Lite version[/b][/i]
[i]Once the main version reaches a sufficiently stable state, a separate Lite version is planned for release.[/i]
[i]The Lite version will focus primarily on the mod’s characters, maps, dialogue, and story content. Breeding and other major gameplay systems will not be included, making it more suitable for players who are mainly interested in exploring the new areas and meeting the characters.[/i][/font]
[line]

[center][b][font=Comic Sans MS][color=#e06666][size=6][i]🔧 INSTALLATION[/i][/size][/color][/font][/b][/center]
[list=1]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Requires [color=#9900ff][b]Stardew Valley 1.6[/b][/color].  [/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Install [color=#cc0000]SMAPI (4.0.0+)[/color] and [color=#cc0000]Spacecore.[/color][/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Unzip Cropgenics into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder. [/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Launch the game through SMAPI.[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][b][i][color=#f6b26b]Generic Mod Config Menu recommended[/color][/i][/b] [/font][/*]
[/list][line]
[center][font=Comic Sans MS][i][color=#d8d8d8][size=6]⚙️ COMPATIBILITY[/size][/color][/i][/font][/center]
[font=Comic Sans MS]✅ Most expansion mods — compatibility included[/font]
[font=Comic Sans MS]✅ Multiplayer — supported, with shared progress [/font]
[font=Comic Sans MS]✅ Works with most vanilla and mod-added crops that follow the game's standard crop data structure[/font]
[font=Comic Sans MS]✅ Install in an existing save[/font]

[line]
[center][size=6][font=Comic Sans MS][i][b]🐛 BUGS & SUGGESTIONS[/b][/i][/font][/size][/center]
[font=Comic Sans MS]Cropgenics is still growing. If something breaks, include steps to reproduce and your SMAPI log (upload at smapi.io/log and paste the link in the Posts tab). [/font]
[font=Comic Sans MS][b][color=#e69138][size=4]Suggestions — new traits, rare flowers, balance feedback, event ideas — are just as welcome; I read every post.[/size][/color][/b][/font]
